diagnosis.failure_mode: The advantages are collapsing to zero, preventing any policy updates. Evidence: (1) Policy entropy remains constant at exactly ln(2)=0.6931472 throughout all 100 iterations, indicating the policy outputs a uniform 50/50 distribution and never changes. (2) Approx KL and clipfrac are exactly 0.0 throughout training, confirming zero policy updates. (3) Policy loss is essentially numerical noise (~1e-7), indicating zero gradient signal. (4) However, the value function IS learning (explained variance increases from ~0% to ~42%, and value loss shows structure), proving rewards are being received. The disconnect between a learning value function and a frozen policy strongly indicates advantages are being incorrectly computed or normalized (e.g., normalization with near-zero std, or incorrect GAE computation), causing all advantages to become zero and eliminating the policy gradient signal.
